23edba0b-22ad-4fe4-8fc5-9cf49d70885b.name: Reverse Engineer
rules: Improvise (Your artifacts can help cast this spell. Each artifact you tap after you're done activating mana abilities pays for {1}.)

642bd9a9-c2ff-4850-bbb7-5dff2293a357.name: Radiation
rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
